floorPlans.note: Flat and Drop are villa plan names used by Emaar. The printed totals cover the components listed on each plan. Confirm the signed area and pool or garden specifications for the selected home.

review.images: Reviewed the official wide hero and all nine gallery images. Omitted a daytime version of the same façade as the hero. The listing card uses the pool-side villa scene.
review.location: Matched the named Emaar project point and visually checked all four times on physical brochure page 5.
review.floorPlans: All nine physical pages are complete villa plans. Checked all imperial area panels, including the five-component Drop sheets on pages 4 and 8. Totals reconcile within 0.01 sq ft.
